Method of Attack: Delivered via malicious PowerPoint attachment exploiting CVE-2017-0199 to execute JScript that downloads and runs syshost.exe
Creates scheduled task Diagnostic_System_Host for persistence
Connects to iplocation.com to gather victim IP and location
Gathers system information (processes, computer name, username, network adapter, drives)
Executes attacker commands and exfiltrates files
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Windows systems with vulnerable Microsoft Office
Attack Vector: Malicious email with PowerPoint attachment sent to Central Tibetan Administration mailing list
Indicators of Compromise: Email address mediabureauin@gmail.com used in Reply-To header
File c:\data.ini containing victim IP and location data
